format: Wizards Black Star Promos (WP): every card came out before Black & White, so the set is Unlimited only, except Flying Pikachu (WP-25) and Surfing Pikachu (WP-28), which Evolutions reprinted (Expanded, v92).

attacks.name: Growl
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon attacks this Pokémon during your opponent's next turn, the damage it does to this Pokémon is reduced by 10 (after Weakness and Resistance). Moving either Pokémon to the Bench ends this effect.

attacks.name: Thundershock
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On heads, the Defending Pokémon becomes Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Light Screen
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, damage done to this Pokémon by an attack (after Weakness and Resistance) is halved, rounded down to the nearest 10. Other effects of attacks still happen.

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On heads, it does 20 more damage.

attacks.name: Energy Absorption
attacks.text: Attach up to 2 Energy cards from your discard pile to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Recharge
attacks.text: Look through your deck for a Lightning Energy card and attach it to this Pokémon. Shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Thunderbolt
attacks.text: Discard all Energy cards attached to this Pokémon in order to use this attack.

abilities.name: Special Delivery
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before you attack), you may draw a card. If you do, put a card from your hand on top of your deck. Not while this Pokémon is Asleep, Confused or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Supersonic Flight
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On tails, this attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On heads, it does 20 more damage.

attacks.name: Flames of Rage
attacks.text: Discard 2 Fire Energy cards attached to this Pokémon in order to use this attack. It does 10 more damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.

attacks.name: First Aid
attacks.text: Remove 1 damage counter from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Double-edge
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 20 damage to itself.

attacks.name: Psywave
attacks.text: 10 damage for each Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Devolution Beam
attacks.text: Choose an evolved Pokémon (yours or your opponent's). Its highest Stage Evolution card goes back to its owner's hand. That Pokémon recovers from Special Conditions and every other effect of attacks, as if it had evolved.

attacks.name: Cat Punch
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On heads, it does 20 damage to the Defending Pokémon. On tails, if your opponent has Benched Pokémon, they choose 1 of them and this attack does 20 damage to it. (No Weakness or Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

abilities.name: Chain Reaction
abilities.text: Whenever a Pokémon evolves (yours or your opponent's, in any way), you may look through your deck for a card that evolves from Eevee and put it onto this Pokémon. That counts as evolving it, with no timing limits. Shuffle your deck. Not while this Pokémon is Asleep, Confused or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Energy Control
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On heads, move a basic Energy card attached to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon to another of their Pokémon (your choice).

attacks.name: Telekinesis
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon (your choice). Don't apply Weakness and Resistance.

abilities.name: Solar Power
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before you attack), you may make your Active Pokémon and the Defending Pokémon recover from Asleep, Confused, Paralyzed and Poisoned. Not while this Pokémon is Asleep, Confused or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Mega Drain
attacks.text: Heal from this Pokémon half the damage this attack did to the Defending Pokémon (after Weakness and Resistance), rounded up to the nearest 10.

attacks.name: Texture Magic
attacks.text: You may change this Pokémon's Resistance to any type but Colorless. If the Defending Pokémon has a Weakness, you may change it to any type but Colorless. Each change lasts until that Pokémon goes to the Bench or evolves.

attacks.name: 3-D Attack
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. 20 damage for each heads.

cards.name: Computer Error
cards.text: You may draw up to 5 cards, then your opponent may draw up to 5 cards. Your turn ends (you don't get to attack).

attacks.name: Tempt
attacks.text: If your opponent has Benched Pokémon, flip a coin. On heads, switch 1 of them (your choice) with the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Poison Claws
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On heads, the Defending Pokémon becomes Poisoned.

attacks.name: Miraculous Comeback
attacks.text: Flip a coin for each Pokémon in play (both players'). 10 damage for each heads, then this Pokémon does 10 damage to itself for each tails.

attacks.name: Synchronize
attacks.text: You can use this attack only if this Pokémon and the Defending Pokémon have the same number of Energy cards attached.

attacks.name: Headache
attacks.text: Your opponent can't play Trainer cards during their next turn.

attacks.name: Fury Swipes
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. 10 damage for each heads.

attacks.name: Hyper Flame
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On heads, discard 1 Fire Energy card attached to this Pokémon; on tails, discard all Energy cards attached to it. If you can't discard, this attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Diamond Dust
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On heads, the Defending Pokémon becomes Paralyzed and this attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (No Weakness or Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Lightning Burn
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On heads, if your opponent has Benched Pokémon, it also does 30 damage to 1 of them (your choice). (No Weakness or Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) On tails, this Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.

attacks.name: Birthday Surprise
attacks.text: If it's your birthday, flip a coin: on heads, it does 50 more damage. (Set your birthday on the main menu.)

attacks.name: Thundershock
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On heads, the Defending Pokémon becomes Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Fly
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On heads, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon during your opponent's next turn. On tails, this attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Thunderbolt
attacks.text: Discard all Energy cards attached to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Thundershock
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On heads, the Defending Pokémon becomes Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Agility
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On heads, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Water Gun
attacks.text: It does 10 more damage for each Energy attached to this Pokémon beyond this attack's cost, up to 20 more.

attacks.name: Snivel
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon attacks this Pokémon during your opponent's next turn, the damage it does to this Pokémon is reduced by 20 (before Weakness and Resistance). Moving either Pokémon to the Bench ends this effect.

attacks.name: Mini-Metronome
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On heads, choose 1 of the Defending Pokémon's attacks and use it as this attack, without its Energy cost (anything else it needs still applies). This Pokémon stays Colorless.

cards.name: Cleffa
cards.text: Baby Rule: if this Baby Pokémon is your Active Pokémon and your opponent announces an attack, they flip a coin before doing anything else. On tails, their turn ends. It can evolve into Clefairy (any card named Clefairy).

attacks.name: Eek
attacks.text: Draw 2 cards.

attacks.name: Paint
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On heads, choose a type other than Colorless and put a Coloring counter on the Defending Pokémon (it loses any it had): it's that type. The counter stays until that Pokémon evolves or leaves play. On tails, this attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Leer
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On heads, the Defending Pokémon can't attack this Pokémon during your opponent's next turn. Moving either Pokémon to the Bench ends this effect.

attacks.name: Metal Pincer
attacks.text: Flip coins until you get tails. It does 10 more damage for each heads.

abilities.name: Bolt
abilities.text: Whenever your opponent's attack damages this Pokémon and doesn't Knock it Out, flip a coin. On heads, shuffle it and all cards attached to it into your deck. Doesn't happen if it was already Asleep, Confused or Paralyzed when it was damaged.

attacks.name: Protective Flame
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to your Benched Pokémon.

cards.name: Pichu
cards.text: Baby Rule: if this Baby Pokémon is your Active Pokémon and your opponent announces an attack, they flip a coin before doing anything else. On tails, their turn ends. It can evolve into Pikachu (any card named Pikachu).

attacks.name: Let's Play!
attacks.text: Look through your deck for a Baby Pokémon card and put it onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck. You can't use this attack if your Bench is full.

cards.name: Igglybuff
cards.text: Baby Rule: if this Baby Pokémon is your Active Pokémon and your opponent announces an attack, they flip a coin before doing anything else. On tails, their turn ends. It can evolve into Jigglypuff (any card named Jigglypuff).

attacks.name: Good Night Song
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon becomes Asleep.

attacks.name: Repeating Kick
attacks.text: Flip coins until you get tails. 20 damage for each heads.

attacks.name: Rapid Spin
attacks.text: After doing damage, if your opponent has Benched Pokémon, they switch 1 of them (their choice) with their Active Pokémon. Then, if you have Benched Pokémon, switch 1 of them with your Active Pokémon.

abilities.name: Join
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before you attack), if you have Unown J, Unown O, Unown I and Unown N on your Bench, you may look through your deck for a Pokémon card, show it to your opponent and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Pain Split
attacks.text: Put 1 damage counter on the Defending Pokémon for each damage counter on this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Confuse Ray
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On heads, the Defending Pokémon becomes Confused.

cards.name: Pokémon Center
cards.text: Remove all damage counters from each of your Pokémon that has any, then discard all Energy cards attached to those Pokémon.

cards.name: Lucky Stadium
cards.text: Once during each player's turn (before attacking), that player may flip a coin. On heads, they draw a card.

cards.name: Pokémon Tower
cards.text: When the effect of a Pokémon Power, an attack, an Energy card or a Trainer card would put a card from a discard pile into its owner's hand, the card stays in the discard pile. (Abilities, Poké-Powers and Poké-Bodies aren't Pokémon Powers.)

attacks.name: Seething Anger
attacks.text: Flip a coin for each damage counter on this Pokémon. It does 10 more damage for each heads.

attacks.name: Fling
attacks.text: After doing damage, if your opponent has Benched Pokémon, they switch 1 of them (their choice) with the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Burning Fire
attacks.text: You may discard any number of Fire Energy cards attached to your Pokémon. It does 10 more damage for each card discarded.

attacks.name: Slashing Strike
attacks.text: This Pokémon can't use Slashing Strike during your next turn (moving it to the Bench or evolving it ends this).

attacks.name: Lightning Rod
attacks.text: Put a Lightning Rod marker on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon (a Pokémon can have only 1). The marker stays until that Pokémon evolves or leaves play.

attacks.name: Lightning Bolt
attacks.text: It also does 20 damage to each Pokémon with a Lightning Rod marker (Weakness and Resistance apply).

abilities.name: Neutral Shield
abilities.text: Prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon by Evolved Pokémon. Not while this Pokémon is Asleep, Confused or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Psyshock
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On heads, the Defending Pokémon becomes Confused.

abilities.name: Aurora Veil
abilities.text: While this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, your Benched Pokémon take no damage from attacks and aren't affected by them (any attack, yours too). Not while this Pokémon has a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Ice Beam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On heads, the Defending Pokémon becomes Paralyzed.

abilities.name: Guard
abilities.text: While this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat. Not while this Pokémon has a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Roll Over
attacks.text: This Pokémon becomes Asleep. Flip a coin. On heads, the Defending Pokémon becomes Asleep too.

attacks.name: Leaf Slice
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. 20 damage for each heads.

attacks.name: Jump Over
attacks.text: If your opponent has Benched Pokémon, choose 1 of them and flip a coin. On heads, this attack does 20 damage to it. (No Weakness or Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Super Singe
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On heads, the Defending Pokémon becomes Burned.

attacks.name: Sacred Wing
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On tails, this attack's base damage is 20 instead of 60.

abilities.name: Pure Body
abilities.text: Whenever you attach a Water Energy card from your hand to this Pokémon, discard an Energy card attached to it (the one just attached may be the one).

attacks.name: Hypno Wave
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On heads, it does 20 more damage. On tails, the Defending Pokémon becomes Asleep.
